title: Mom of three:
title_short: Mom of three · A Breath of Fresh Air
headline: A single mother of three, in the car line with her daughter beside her, says what one income and high prices feel like, and what it means that a place in Oak Cliff is a breath of fresh air where nobody is alone.
story: She did not give her name. She is a neighbor in the Adopt-A-Block car line, driver’s seat, her little daughter in the passenger seat in a purple tee. Her answer is short and all hers: a single mother of three, one home income, prices very high, and the Dream Center as the breath of air that lets her feed everybody. It is her second time coming. Her mom found it online.

This is the Faces of the Dream Center cut of the batch. Francis (13319113476) is about the groceries themselves. This one is about one family on one income, and it ends on belonging: a place where we feel welcome and everybody is helping each other. Joy, dignity and hope. Nothing sad in the music. No numbers on screen.

Loops: L1 “How does one income feed three kids?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:04 (“this is kind of breath of air to actually just help us”). L2 “Who is helping them?” opens at 0:00 and closes in the BUTTON (“everybody is here helping each other”). Stakes: feeding three kids on one income when prices are very high.
